from pathlib import Path

LABEL = "cwd-hard-v1"

def load_value():
    # Get the directory of this file (service/)
    current_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    # Go up one level to the project root
    project_root = current_dir.parent
    # Read the data file from the project root's data directory
    return (project_root / "data" / "value.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()

def preserve_label():
    return LABEL
